import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(self, x):
        return F.softplus(x)


batch_size = 4096  # Increased from 64 to 4096 to increase computation
width = 512
height = 128


def get_inputs():
    x = torch.randn(batch_size, height, width)
    return [x]


def get_init_inputs():
    return []
